faqLeft.q: What engine does the Land Rover Discovery Sport D200 use?
faqLeft.a: The Discovery Sport D200 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel, introduced in 2020 as part of the diesel range update for the L550 generation.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover Discovery Sport D200 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,000. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Discovery Sport D200?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact engine code before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200D Discovery Sport D200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Discovery Sport D200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Discovery Sport D200 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Discovery Sport D200 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Discovery Sport owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
